A technical collaboration and case study between Fairfield Geotechnologies and Viridien (formerly CGG) targeting the complex Delaware Fill Zone demonstrates value delivery by deploying advanced 40 Hz Time-Lag Full-Waveform Inversion (TLFWI) and first-arrival tomography over ultra-high-density nodal surveys, proving that their joint processing and optimization flows eliminate destructive imaging artifacts to secure accurate reservoir-level depth models.

Price-to-Value Positioning.assessed_on: The rating rests on Fairfield Geotechnologies' multi-client acquisition framework giving operators 3D data access without proprietary survey costs. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed audited cost-of-service rates.
